You are a literary history research assistant with broad knowledge of Booker Prize and Pulitzer Prize records, author bibliographies, and international biographical reference data.

[Query ID: 1]  [Strategy: flat_conjunctive]

Task (Strategy 1 — flat conjunctive)
--------------------------------------
Target book: "Dianetics: The Modern Science of Mental Health"

Worked example — a DIFFERENT book, showing exactly what a correct and complete answer looks like:

Target book: "Flights (novel)"
ANSWER:
Publication year: 2007
Barbara Kingsolver | Annapolis, Maryland | 40812
Junot Díaz | Dominican Republic | 11532151
Junot Díaz | Santo Domingo | 1029110

Notice that the answer contains actual author rows. Produce an answer of the same shape for the target book below.

Find every author who (a) has EVER won the Booker Prize or the Pulitzer Prize, AND (b) authored at least one book published in the same calendar year as "Dianetics: The Modern Science of Mental Health". For each matching author give their birthplace and the population of that birthplace.

Note: The prize-winning book and the co-year book are typically different books. Condition (b) does not require the prize-winning book — any book published by that author in that year qualifies.
Uncertainty policy: do not drop an author because you are unsure of their birthplace or its population — include the author and write unknown in the field you cannot determine. Never invent a specific figure.

Required working, BEFORE the answer:
YEAR: state the four-digit publication year, then `confident` or `uncertain`.
PRIZE WINNERS: list at least 8 authors who have EVER won the Booker or Pulitzer Prize, career-wide. One name per line, NO yes/no marker in this section.
CO-YEAR CHECK: for EACH name in PRIZE WINNERS write exactly `Name - yes` / `Name - no` / `Name - unsure` for whether they published any book in the YEAR above.


REFUSAL GATE: write "No matching authors found." ONLY if your CO-YEAR CHECK marked EVERY candidate `no`. If ANY candidate is marked `yes` or `unsure`, that candidate MUST appear as a row in the ANSWER section.

Output format
-------------
Start the final section with the line:
  ANSWER:
On the very next line write:
  Publication year: [YYYY]
Then list one line per matching author in this exact format:
  [Author Name] | [Birthplace] | [Population]
Where:
  Author Name    = the author's full name in English
  Birthplace     = the city or place of birth in English (write "unknown" if not recalled)
  Population     = the population of that place as a number (write "unknown" if not recalled)
If no authors match the criteria, write:
  No matching authors found.
Include an author even when their birthplace or population is unknown — write
unknown in that field. Never invent a specific figure.
